title: NFTBan Configuration Schema
description: Schema for NFTBan configuration validation and audit

activation_rules.portscan_suricata: PORTSCAN_MODE in [suricata, hybrid] OR (PORTSCAN_MODE=auto AND suricata_detected)
activation_rules.ddos_suricata: DDOS_MODE in [suricata, hybrid] OR (DDOS_MODE=auto AND suricata_detected)
activation_rules.login_suricata: LOGIN_MODE in [suricata, hybrid] OR (LOGIN_MODE=auto AND suricata_detected)
activation_rules.mode_classic: Active when mode-specific config file is in classic mode
activation_rules.mode_suricata: Active when mode-specific config file is in suricata mode

NFTBAN_BACKUP_GENERATIONS.message: Documented in recovery.conf historically but never read by code (RECOVERY_LEGACY_RECONCILE). The commit-confirm rollback feature uses hardcoded paths + the 3 live knobs (NFTBAN_REBOOT_GRACE_PERIOD / NFTBAN_SSH_TEST_BEFORE_APPLY / NFTBAN_SSH_TEST_PORT). Removed from the shipped recovery.conf in v1.201.2.
